claim_scope: named M2 law, M3 support, this realization and split

evaluation.comparison_rule: Report method-by-target results and paired entity uncertainty only for predeclared contrasts. No universal scalar model leaderboard.
metrics: objective/gradient evaluations and simulated daily-state transitions (deterministic compute proxy)
paired_contrasts: full minus reduced for P_223_kg, separately by lift and noise condition
uniform-prior Bayesian minus full MLE for each estimable target, separately by lift and noisy condition
Beta(8,8)-prior Bayesian minus uniform-prior Bayesian for each estimable target, separately by lift and noisy condition
hybrid minus full MLE for DeltaC_56_kg, separately by lift and noise condition
full MLE noise scale 2 minus noise scale 1 for each target, separately by lift
full MLE noise scale 1 minus noise scale 0 for each target, separately by lift
targets: each named physical parameter and normalized coordinate

hypotheses: H1: Noise-free direct reconstruction recovers the final expressed-performance target, but this alone does not establish capacity, state, or parameter recovery.
H2: Single-time observations cannot locally identify both free adaptation and suppression states because every channel factors through expressed performance.
H3: Full bounded fitting and Bayesian fitting may retain substantial state or parameter error despite good expressed-performance fit; recovery is assessed separately for every target.
H4: Posterior uncertainty and prior sensitivity are condition-dependent; a narrow posterior under Beta(8,8) is not treated as data-driven identification.

H5: A development-only bounded residual correction may change held-out capacity-change prediction error, but cannot improve state or parameter recovery because those outputs are copied from the full structural fit.

identifiability.constant_input: Recompute the RES-287 reference-stimulus/gain symmetry for constant dose-intensity product 0.6 and state explicitly that this is outside canonical historical templates.
identifiability.equivalent_solution_rule: Record a candidate equivalence when objective difference is at most 1e-6, P-history RMSE is at most 1e-6 kg, and maximum normalized-coordinate difference exceeds 1e-3.
identifiability.free_state: No free-initial-state inference is used or transferred.
identifiability.global_decision: An exact admissible native-template counterexample establishes non-uniqueness for that design. Absence of a found counterexample or full local rank is INCONCLUSIVE for global identification.
identifiability.jacobian: Midpoint normalized-coordinate central differences at 1e-5 and 5e-6, 32 weekly P outputs per lift, four canonical templates, plus zero-input low-excitation sensitivity; relative rank threshold 1e-8.

bayesian.rule: MAP and bounded local Laplace approximation using the exact accepted-assessment likelihood; Uniform and independent Beta(8,8) priors on normalized coordinates. Noise-free posterior is undefined.

full.rule: Bounded maximum-likelihood fit of all 16 coordinates under the known zero-state model; derive all declared targets.

hybrid.rule: Full structural outputs plus a Ridge correction for DeltaC_56, fitted on development entities only, alpha=1 on standardized features, correction clipped to [-20,20] kg. State and parameter outputs are exactly those of the full fit.

reduced.rule: P_223 estimate equals the newest assessment; estimate no other target.

optimization.convergence: A solver success flag and finite objective are required for CONVERGED. Failed, nonfinite, boundary, and multimodal results remain recorded.
optimization.likelihood_support: If a proposal implies zero likelihood for an accepted assessment/load ratio, use a fixed 1e6 quadratic distance penalty to the feasible z=a/P support interval [0.4/0.71, 1/0.68] only to guide optimization. Such proposals are ineligible as final fits; every selected noisy fit is scored with the exact accepted-assessment likelihood.
optimization.noise_free_solver: Bounded trust-region reflective least squares with analytic Jacobian, lower bound 0 and upper bound nextafter(1,0), max_nfev=500, ftol=xtol=gtol=1e-11.
optimization.noisy_solver: L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient, lower bound 0 and upper bound nextafter(1,0), maxiter=100, ftol=1e-10, gtol=1e-6, maxfun=3000.
optimization.selection: Retain every start. Select the lowest finite objective among converged starts; if none converged, retain the lowest finite result and flag it nonconverged. No refits or budget extensions are allowed after outcomes are inspected.

participant_information.estimator_feature_rule: All four method families receive the same assessment-only observation channel and known schedules. The newest-assessment reduced estimator and the dynamic structural methods differ only in their declared equations and history use.
visible: past daily dose and intensity schedule through day 223

prohibited_claims: global native-template uniqueness from local rank or finite starts
structural recovery from lower prediction error
protocol.question: Under the known public native zero-initial-state dynamics and participant-visible weekly assessment histories, which expressed, latent, state, and parameter quantities can be reconstructed, with what uncertainty, and does a learned residual improve future capacity-change prediction without improving structural recovery?

realization.future_plan: The four M3 plan declarations; each split has eight entities per plan, each covering days 224-279.
realization.history: Four canonical M3 weekly schedule templates; each split has eight entities per template for each lift.
realization.noise_rule: Scale the M2 assessment and velocity innovations by the declared factor; retain the native load-fraction and valid-observation domain; rejection-sample invalid observations up to 1000 attempts. Noise zero is deterministic. Each entity, schedule, and plan is shared across noise conditions.
realization.population: 64 public-native entities drawn from the M2 IID coordinate transform.
realization.realization_class: New PUBLIC_NATIVE study realization, separate from canonical M3/G1 realizations and all M0-M5 data.
realization.split: Development entity indices 0-31; held-out test entity indices 32-63. Split is entity-disjoint. No selection split is used; all hyperparameters are fixed in the protocol.

structural_prior.initial_state: Native A[-1]=R[-1]=0; free initial states are prohibited.
structural_prior.law: Frozen M2 daily equations and public M2 population transforms are known exactly.
structural_prior.model_scope: Same-law public-native synthetic identification only; no unknown-model, physiological, causal, or real-athlete claim.
structural_prior.parameter_bounds: The 16 population coordinates are independently bounded in [0,1); the numerical optimizer uses 0 and the largest representable float below 1. Physical parameter transforms and supports are the public M2 population contract.

target_quantities.estimand: 16 public normalized population coordinates and transformed physical parameters
target_quantities.name: parameters
target_quantities.unit: kg, dimensionless, or days by parameter

uncertainty.bayesian: 512 in-support multivariate-normal draws from each valid Laplace approximation; 95% equal-tail intervals; Hessian must be positive definite with condition number <=1e10; MAP must be at least 1e-3 from every coordinate bound; all posterior failures are retained.
uncertainty.paired_bootstrap: 1000 entity-level paired percentile replicates, separately by lift, target, noise, and declared method contrast; do not pool units or lifts into a universal score.
uncertainty.prior_sensitivity: Compare Uniform with Beta(8,8) by target-wise posterior mean, interval width, and coverage; no result-driven prior changes.
